d:
Fejo presents his latest Malayalam Rap Song Aayiram Aura 🏻
From poetic metaphors to powerful declarations, this track is about using pain as fuel, rising above challenges & leaving a lasting legacy
Rooted in Kerala’s spirit, it reflects standing tall when alone & etching your mark in diamonds
Music Composition - Fejo
Vocals & Lyrics - Fejo
Beat Production - Jeffin Jestin
Visuals & Designs - Rambro
Guitar - Martin Netto
